summary: Password input error interactivity fix, auto-select on error, and focus state error clearing.

changes.text: Restored input interactivity and un-disabled state upon password verification errors.
Added auto .focus() and .select() on password fields after authentication error triggers.
Added automatic error state clearing when focusing into any password input field.
Updated release badges and installer download links to v1.1.36.

summary: Defect fix for Activity Log DOM state refresh when resuming session after unlock.

changes.text: Fixed Activity Log DOM state refresh when resuming session after unlock.
Updated release badge and download installer URLs to v1.1.35.

summary: Critical renderer UI audit release resolving password eye toggles, seed grid rendering, recovery copy standards, and file attachment icons.

changes.text: Eliminated string corruption and visual overlap on password eye toggle unmasking across all vault forms.
Restored 24-word recovery phrase grid rendering in authenticated memory on the Recovery Seed view.
Purged unencrypted seed phrase storage from localStorage to prevent security leaks.
Purged inaccurate 'Backup' wording across recovery verification modals.
Integrated custom high-contrast vector inline SVGs for file attachment types (Images, PDFs, Archives, and Binaries).

summary: Renderer UI overhaul, dynamic entry field schemas, dark container boxes, vector SVGs, and portable vault JSON exports.

changes.text: Added comprehensive field schemas for Financial, Legal, and Personal vault entry types.
Redesigned entry cards with prominent titles, category badges, dark field containers, and copy tooltips.
Updated vault JSON export format to include self-contained Argon2id KDF parameters and salt.
Replaced all raw emoji symbols across renderer components with inline vector SVGs.

summary: Beta report administration dashboard, Ed25519 WebCrypto client-side report signing, and public verifier portal.

changes.text: Implemented /admin/beta-reports password-protected moderation dashboard with strict authentication.
Implemented /beta-sign Ed25519 in-browser cryptographic report signing workflow.
Implemented /beta-testers public trust portal displaying verified signed beta tester reports.
Enforced local Ed25519 signature validation with immediate private key discard.

summary: Landing page FAQ overhaul, trust portal legal pages, local vault storage paths, and update guidance.

changes.text: Added Privacy Policy (privacy.html) and Terms of Service (terms.html) pages.
Expanded FAQ section with OS storage paths, multi-device rules, and computer transfer guidance.
Separated Platform Specs and Hardware & Kernel Memory Isolation into distinct sections.
Updated support contact to support@vantalocksecure.com.

summary: Stabilized release with onboarding state checks, UI button label refinements, and enhanced Security Center options.

changes.text: Enforced cryptographic master password verification across all vault password input forms.
Added support for encrypted file attachments across Financial, Legal, and Personal vault compartments.
Resolved onboarding state persistence check to route incomplete setups directly to onboarding.
Updated release download URLs and badges to version v1.1.30.

knownIssues: Hardware biometrics integration currently requires manual SafeStorage entitlement configuration on some Linux distros.

summary: Full layout refactor, 24-word recovery phrase grid, dark theme selector, and automated CI/CD workflow build.

changes.text: Integrated 4 dark themes: Pure Black, Obsidian Gold, Cyber Emerald, and Midnight Sapphire.
Added Panic Lock button and Ctrl+Shift+L global keyboard shortcut.
Eliminated startup splash screen animation hang with defensive pointer event handling.
Automated GitHub Actions installer package builds for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

knownIssues: Initial setup onboarding greeting modal can briefly flash prior to JavaScript view initialization.
